newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kin Yat shares debut at HK$2.20.
newsitem.headline: Kin Yat shares debut at HK$2.20.

text.p: Shares of remote control toy cars manufacturer Kin Yat Holdings Ltd debuted at HK$2.20 per share on Thursday compared with an issue price of HK$1.28.
The shares retreated to HK$1.96 after the first five minutes of trade with a total of 3.74 million shares worth HK$8.81 million changed hands.
Kin Yat offered 85 million shares at an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong, of which 76.5 million shares available for public subscription were 523 times subscribed.
The Hong Kong-based company manufactures toy cars and electrical household appliances.

Kin Yat said the net proceeds raised from the new issue of HK$96.8 million would be used in buying new plant and machinery for two new production facilities located in Shenzhen and Shaoguan in China, and to expand products development project.
